This is a just barely in-time update for the annual April Fool’s Day project!

The story this time is part of the IF Story series that have been released up till now, but it is a slightly different type of story. Of course, I wanted to write it, so I wrote it as I liked.

What kind of story could it be? I hope you enjoy it and I look forward to seeing you in the afterword!

――It was probably an instance where a single misstep sent the entire journey astray.

With but a single misalignment of gears, the tale twisted askew, and the rails of fate changed course with ease.

When the expected flow of events shifted, the torrent of destiny tossed people around like leaves from a tree.

And yet, what if they still finally found their way unto that changeless shore on the other side, unyielding?

Surely, it was only when a strong, unwavering desire utterly deceived that Commandment.

It was precisely within that once-in-a-lifetime lie that the meaning of that man’s life dwelled.

△▼△▼△▼△

???: [Haa, haa… hk!]

The girl panted as she fled, desperately clutching the child’s hand.

Despite running with all her might, the girl’s speed was lacking. For, within this unfamiliar land, one of her legs was impaired. ――Nay, if one called it an unfamiliar land, then for this girl, the whole world was strange.

This was a place she did not recognize whatsoever, these circumstances were beyond her comprehension, and as for her current situation, she could fathom naught.

Thus――,

???: [Uu! Uu, aau!]

Dragged by the girl’s hand, the child, whose name she did not even know, had been continuously wailing inarticulate cries.

Girl: [――Hk.]

Tightly biting her lips, the girl banished the weakness within her mind and faced ahead.

Indeed, at this moment, everything was unknown to her.. However, certain truths were clear. She knew that she must not let go of this child’s hand, and that she must continue to run forward.

In the midst of this world awash with unknowns, the girl’s instinct cried out for her to flee. Escape was the sole means by which the girl could express her will to resist; a protest permitted to her present self.

Girl: [That, person… hk.]

Whilst experiencing a pain that seared her breath-starved lungs, the girl’s bewildered mind envisioned a single figure. It had the appearance of a boy with black hair and mean-looking eyes, and its very presence evoked both negative impulses as well as strange feelings――,

???: [――Oh, it’s really an Oni. That’s unusual.]

Girl: [――Hk.]

That carefree voice suddenly intruded on the girl’s thoughts, sending a tremor throughout her body, and she sharply whirled about.

Mirrored in the girl’s pale blue eyes was a one-eyed woman wearing an eyepatch who was running―― nay, flying beside her. She was a beautiful woman with the animal ears of a dogperson and much of her brown skin exposed to the wind. At the entrance of the woman cutting through the air with a long branch in her grasp, the child that was being dragged behind the girl let out a shriek.

The moment she heard that scream, the girl reflexively attempted to fend off the woman with her free hand.

However――,

Woman: [――? That didn’t connect. It’s a shame, but…]

Off-balance, her swung arm was seized effortlessly, and in turn, she found herself pulled in.

Their faces had drawn so near to one another that the tips of their noses were about to touch, and in the woman’s red eye uncovered by an eyepatch, the girl beheld her own visage in its reflection.

It was an unfamiliar face. ――That was the face of a girl who did not understand the world, let alone herself.

Woman: [I was told to capture you.]

Girl: [――Ah.]

The instant the girl beheld her reflection, the woman lightly tapped the center of her chest with a finger, and the girl felt a minute shock course throughout her entire body.

The action had effortlessly stolen the strength from the girl’s limbs, forcing her to collapse to her knees.

Girl: [Ugh!]

Woman: [That child, too.]

Beside the collapsed girl, the brave child leapt at the woman. 

However, the woman caught the strike with the ease of twisting a baby’s hand, and then, that same shock the girl had endured was delivered to the child’s brow, and with an “Aauu?”, she flopped and toppled over as if all her strength had been sapped away.

As a result, the chase sequence starring the girl and the small child reached its anticlimactic conclusion. 

Girl: [You, are…]

Woman: [Don’t worry, no harm will… well, I’m not sure. Sorry.]

As the girl crawled toward the dazed child, straining her voice, the woman offered words of apology. But, that was by no means a consolation, as there was no sense of being saved by that apology.

Whether she ought to deem it sincerity or clumsiness, the girl could choose neither.

Slowly but surely, as the child before her slipped into unconsciousness, so too did her own reality begin to fade away.

Woman: [Let’s go, Oni girl.]

Girl: [I, am…]

The sensation of being picked up by the woman was an action she could not resist. As her consciousness gradually faded to white, the girl’s lips trembled feebly.

Being called an Oni failed to resonate with her. That being said, there was another way she had been called――,

Rem: [――Rem.]

That name had been spoken by the black-haired boy enveloped in that dreadful, abhorrent stench. 

Perhaps, it was some kind of illusion. ――That above all else, that name somehow felt familiar to her empty self that lacked anything.

△▼△▼△▼△

――Things had taken a troublesome turn.

A combination of dread and vigilance coursed like lightning through Natsuki Subaru’s mind, compelling him to act urgently.

Why, why, why; he had not even a moment to spare in order to ponder such a question.

He organized his thoughts concerning recent events: the arrival of the opportunity for a long-awaited reunion, and the bitter sorrow that came thereafter when reality had failed to meet his hopes. Suppressing that grief, focusing his mind on the precious people he had been separated from, he steeled his resolve to escape this irrational, senseless impasse―― at least, that was what he ought to do.

And yet――,

???: [Kakakakka! Ya young’uns really are terrifyin’! Even I’ve never seen one with this much recklessness, impossibility, and sheer madness. Amazin’, amazin’.]

The hoarse voice rang out in a hearty laugh, accompanied by a knifehand thrust like steel that struck his heart. 

His back was pierced by the knifehand, and as he beheld his own heart torn from his chest, in a tempest of agony and shock, Subaru died instantly.

×  ×  ×

???: [How did a friggin’ human like yourself slip past the watch of us dragons? I don’t know how the frig’ you did, and that fact I don’t is the height of friggin’ disrespect!]

Bearing a sweet outward appearance, the tantrum of this destructive being was clad in a tempest with a single swing of her arm.

That slender arm did not even need to make contact with him, stirring up a gale which seized the boy’s body and hurled him against the castle walls. Tasting the pain of all of his bones shattering, Subaru died instantly.

×  ×  ×

???: [Deceived… my eyes. Do not understand… how? Scary.]

The shapeshifting statue in the beautiful garden voiced its dread, swinging down an arm that resembled a marble pillar.

Once, then twice, he had managed to evade the arm, but he could not do so forever. The third blow grazed his leg, robbing his body of all mobility, followed by the fourth strike landing a direct blow on him, and as he was compressed to a tenth of his original size, Subaru died instantly.

×  ×  ×

???: [――! Who are you! Don’t you realize whose castle this is, you fool!]

With a gallant, inflexible, righteous fury, sharp thorns flashed like blades.

His whole body was ensnared by purple vines covered in thorns, and as every bit of his flesh was rent asunder, as Subaru’s consciousness was shattered by the unbearable pain of his spilt blood and how the thorns on the vines writhing like they had a will of their own were gnawing at his wounds, he breathed his last.

×  ×  ×

???: [There he is! Don’t let him get away!!]

???: [You villain!]

???: [Do you think you can get away with this!?]

He was cornered by bearers of steel who had flushed out their prey, holding a will to fight that had been honed.

Surrounded on all sides, with neither a place to escape, nor anyone who would lend an ear to his excuses, the thrusting blades pierced his entire body, and suffering all of those mortal wounds, Subaru collapsed and breathed his last.

×  ×  ×

Subaru: [In the first place――]

Subaru gritted his teeth, wondering if he had erred in his choices from the outset, having repeated Death five times. 

Subaru had already been alone at the new starting point of Return by Death. ――It may have been a mistake to end up here alone in the first place.

When he thought about how she might be suffering the same things he had even at this very moment, that alone was enough turmoil to crack and shatter his heart.

What was it that he needed?

What possibilities must he secure?

Where was the checkpoint that he must reach?

Walking a tightrope that was far too narrow and unreliable, having to reach the other side no matter the cost, what exactly was it that Subaru must be able to fulfill? 

Subaru: [――――]

It was a situation where he must attract attention, yet if Subaru moved carelessly, he would be obstructed by a tough opponent that was far and away beyond his own abilities, and they would take his life all too quickly.

There were a great many enemies. And not a single one had a shred of mercy. ――Subaru’s path was blocked by individuals who had absolutely no qualms about killing their opponents.

In order to break through that, to surmount it, that tiny, minute gap in the possibilities, he would――

Subaru: [――――]

Running over carefully tidied lawns, Subaru headed in a different direction than all the other routes which had been closed off to him, and found an opulent detached palace. 

Gaudy and beautiful, yet less gaudy compared the castle that Subaru had just been trying and failing to escape, and he would hope that it had a bit less stringent security.

Accordingly, he should be able to obtain at least a single piece of information. ――With such an intention, Subaru smashed a window in a place void of any signs of people, unlocked it, and tumbled into the Imperial Residence.

In the next instant――,

???: [――You fool.]

He had climbed over the window frame and just put the tips of his toes on the floor.

As soon as he heard that weighty, stern voice, Subaru’s legs were clipped from the side, and he was mercilessly slammed headfirst into the floor. 

Subaru: [Oguahh!]

The instant he let out a shriek of pain and his vision flickered red, the worst scenarios flashed through his mind.

After all, up to now, Subaru had repeatedly ended up having his life stolen away from him by completely different people in different ways, all in the span of around ten minutes. 

That’s why it was no wonder that, in the midst of the pain, he had resigned himself to it being the same again.

However――,

???: [You, how did you manage to evade the security and get in here?]

The expected arrival of the shock of Death did not befall him, but instead, a question was asked of him.  

While grimacing in pain, Subaru lay sprawled out spread-eagle on the floor, and he caught a glimpse of the person who had raised that query to him―― the one who had intercepted Subaru sneaking into the Imperial Residence. 

Subaru: [――――]

Standing there, with black hair and black eyes, was a handsome man with tidy features that gave off the impression of a frightening intellect. That individual wearing a crimson outfit that conveyed the quality of its tailoring with a single glance was warily looking down upon Subaru with a gaze as sharp as that of a bird of prey.

That glare usurped his conscious thought, and Subaru froze like he had been pinned down. ――And yet, it was not simply the gaze of the handsome man that had immobilized Subaru. 

Handsome Man: [Did you not hear my question? It would be irreverent to not provide any answer.]

With an austere voice and words, the handsome man was about to callously decide Subaru’s fate. 

However, rather than this cruel reality, Subaru’s awareness was seized by the strange phenomenon before his eyes―― the profound mystery within the full-length mirror placed beside the handsome man looking down on him.

Upon the mirror, the reflected image of the dark-haired handsome man was different. ――Reflected there was a man, taller than the handsome man with black hair, possessing white hair, white clothes, and a pale face.

As Subaru gasped at the peculiarity of that, the handsome man in reality shut one eye and tapped his foot.

And then, as if an ultimatum, he asked a question once more.

Handsome Man: [There shall not be a third time. Take care, and answer my question.]

Subaru blinked at the overlapping images, and then his consciousness returned to reality.

Then, the figure of the man in white who had just been visible within the mirror a moment prior was nowhere to be seen, and all that remained was the form of the handsome man who stared at him with a dreadfully overbearing attitude.

Seeing this, Subaru swallowed his breath, and then spoke.

Subaru: [――My name is Natsuki Subaru.]

It was an inadequate answer to any of the questions that the handsome man had asked.

Thinking back on it later, even Subaru himself could not think of a proper reason why he had given his name here, had introduced himself without falsifying his identity.

He could only assume that it was an intuitive answer, drawn from his brain which had become confused due to erratically and reflexively accumulating absurd and irrational Deaths over and over again within a short span of time.

Hearing that answer of Subaru’s that could easily strike a nerve with someone, the handsome man――,

Handsome Man: [――Lugunica’s… Lolimancer, is it?]

Yes, he raised his finely shaped eyebrows, and with a hint of bewilderment that did not suit his face, which was like the embodiment of an arrogance that placed all the events of the world within his own palms, he muttered so.

――This itself, was the first misstep.

Natsuki Subaru, who had unexpectedly been sent to the Sacred Vollachian Empire, and “Vincent Vollachia”, the pinnacle of the Land of the Sword Wolves―― it was the meeting of the two whose destinies should never have crossed paths in the first place, comrades who would deceive fate.

△▼△▼△▼△

???: [――I’ve brought them.]

Saying that, the one who brazenly stepped into the office of the Imperial Residence was a young girl with a strangely revealing outfit that showed off her brown skin, dog ears, and an eyepatch over her left eye; she was overloaded with character traits.

Subaru was taken aback by her appearance, but when he saw that she was carrying Rem upon her slender shoulders and an extra person under her arm, he exclaimed “Rem!” as he hurriedly rushed over.

Subaru: [Are you hurt anywhere?… Opossum!]

Eyepatch Girl: [Don’t do that so suddenly, it surprised me.]

As he tried to ensure she was safe, toes drilled into his defenseless solar plexus and he fell in agony.

The girl with the eyepatch had only casually lifted her bare foot, but it was not a matter of the strength of her legs, but rather of the skill to precisely gouge his vitals―― no, it was a brutal, instinctual kick without any such calculation behind it.

However, despite having his organs bored through by the shock, Subaru staggered over to Rem, slung over the girl’s shoulder, and after confirming her breathing and the tinge of red on her cheeks, he heaved a sigh of relief.

Subaru: […It seems like nothing bad. She’ll actually wake up, right?]

Eyepatch Girl: [I only put her to sleep. She’ll wake up soon. This one too.]

Subaru: [I don’t care about that one. If anything, I’d rather she’d stay asleep forever.]

Eyepatch Girl: […Your relationships are… complicated?]

Subaru: [Not at all. Rem is important, that one isn’t. That’s all.]

Subaru glared at the blonde girl being held under the girl’s arm opposite to Rem.

At his declaration, the girl’s one red eye widened and her lips twitched. It seemed like Subaru’s answer was not to her liking in some way, but unfortunately it was his true thoughts.

But it was impossible to mend things between them. ――Unlike the courageous, gentle, hard-working, and compassionate Rem, that girl was a monster who had piled up a mountain of unpardonable sins.

Subaru: [――Louis Arneb.]

With a whisper, Subaru muttered the girl’s―― the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony’s name.

Right now, she seemed to be sleeping, but she was one of the enemies who had thoroughly tormented him during the battles at the Pleiades Watchtower and made him experience hell. It was a mystery as to why she, who was supposed to be an incorporeal entity, had manifested with a body in reality, but there was no way she was up to anything good.

In any case――,

Subaru: [Thank you for not hurting Rem. You are…?]

Eyepatch Girl: [Arakiya.]

Subaru: [Thanks, Arakiya-chan! I’m in your debt!]

Bowing deeply, Subaru expressed his gratitude toward the girl―― toward Arakiya.

Although she probably did not hold a favorable impression of Subaru due to his treatment of Louis a moment ago, for his part, Subaru felt a strong sense of gratitude and debt toward Arakiya.

And the person who had ordered Arakiya to do this for him was――,

Subaru: [Thank you for saving us. Umm…] 

???: [――Vincent Vollachia.]

Subaru: [――――]

Vincent: [Seventy-seventh Emperor of the Sacred Vollachian Empire, Vincent Vollachia.]

The one who introduced himself once again was the handsome man with black hair, sitting behind an ebony desk.

This person was the one who had confronted Subaru when he had snuck into the Imperial Residence and had come one step short of striking him down for his insolence. And, if the name he had just given was the truth, he was the most powerful man in the Empire.

Subaru: [Arakiya-chan?]

Arakiya: [It’s true… or a bit of a lie?]

Subaru: [A bit of a lie?]

Vincent: [Arakiya, do not talk out of turn. ――If you wish to regain what you truly desire, take care to conduct yourself in a manner that does not upset my good graces.]

Arakiya: […Nnh.]

Arakiya, who had responded to Subaru and his attempt at confirmation, was rebuked by that handsome man―― by Vincent, and she nodded with a look of slight discontent.

Arakiya lowered Rem and Louis onto a sofa for guests, and let them sleep. As for Subaru, he wanted to separate the two sleeping there as much as possible, but since he lacked the situation or the standing to make such a request, he simply clenched his fists tightly and endured it.

After all, this was the Sacred Vollachian Empire.

Subaru had spent a year learning the culture and general knowledge of this other world; and this was the neighboring nation of the Kingdom of Lugunica, which differed from it starting from the soil on up, the Imperial Capital where a figure of most august rank resided. 

Vincent: [So? Lolimancer, explain it to me once more.]

Subaru: […Rather than that, could you please refer to me as Natsuki Subaru? As you can see, I don’t have the lovely, charming, pretty girl that makes me worthy of the title with me right now.]

Arakiya: [What about this child?]

Subaru: [She’s a girl who’s not lovely, nor charming, nor pretty.]

Subaru gave a curt response to Arakiya, who had inquired thus while pointing at Louis. Then, he turned his gaze back toward Vincent once again, and the Emperor closed one of his black eyes.

Vincent: [Speak, Natsuki Subaru.]

Subaru: […No matter how many times you ask, it won’t change much. We were at the tower of the Sage, in the far east of Lugunica. A lot happened at the tower, but I’ll leave that out… In the end, part of the Witch of Envy overflowed from the shrine near the Great Waterfall and swallowed us. Then, the next thing I knew, I was flung to the grounds of this castle…]

Arakiya: […Your story sounds like a lie. Are you lying?]

Subaru: [I get what I’m saying is totally suspicious, but on the other hand there is no reason for me to give you a story that is nothing but lies, so I’d like you to believe me…!]

He had thought he had laid out the facts, but Arakiya was rightly suspicious.

However, it was the person concerned, Subaru, who wanted an explanation of the situation. After finishing the battle with the Gluttonies at the Pleiades Watchtower, and then losing a companion he did not want to lose under the pretense of a Trial, and just as his frayed heart had begun to settle, this had occurred.

Subaru: [I’m sure Emilia-tan, Beako, and the others are quite worried right about now… Something like, “I can’t believe you, you ended up in the Empire somehow, and on the grounds of the castle of the Imperial Capital no less.”]

Vincent: [That you are a spy quite lacking in the skill of your excuses, contrary the skill of your infiltration, is currently the most likely explanation. If there is a point of note, it is that you identify yourself as Natsuki Subaru.]

Subaru: […It’s not a lie, I’m telling the truth, but was that really that significant to you?]

Vincent: [It is well known to the Empire that the Lolimancer is one of the Knights to a Candidate for the Royal Selection. The menaces of the Witch Cult and the Three Great Witchbeasts are not something that even Vollachia is isolated from.]

Subaru: [I see…]

Vincent: [A non-aggression pact was signed between the Empire and the Kingdom. I could insist that your mere presence here has shattered that agreement, however…]

Subaru: [No, that’s, well you know, I plead for your forgiveness.]

It would be terrible if Subaru carelessly giving out his name was the cause of the two nations plunging into a state of war. In the first place, this was truly an unfortunate misunderstanding, an unforeseen accident.

Subaru had no way to explain it, and it was shameful that he could do nothing but desperately insist that the truth that appeared to be a lie was, in fact, the truth, but――,

???: [My ohhh~ my, that’s just a bit too much of a threat, now isn’t it, Your Excellency? I don’t think we can afford to deal with the Kingdom right now, myself.]

Subaru: [――! W-who are you!?]

Subaru’s shoulders twitched at the unexpected voice of a third-party, and he turned around. When he did, he found that the office door had opened slightly, and his eyes met with the suspicious person peeking through the opening.

The suspicious person whom he had made eye contact with waved at Subaru, and opened the door with a defiant smile. Then, with broad strides, he brazenly stepped foot into the office.

Suspicious Man: [In accordance with my commandment, I have been called here, Your Excellency.]

Vincent: [I do not remember calling for you.]

Suspicious Man: [I didn’t saaay~ that, though? I said, in accordance with my commandment. I rarely get the chance to, so when the odd opportunity comes, I need to act as a proper Stargazer.]

The one who responded with a frivolous smile to Vincent, the Emperor, was a gentle-looking effeminate man with long ashen hair.

He seemed to have a different air about him than the soldiers he had seen in the castle, or the transcendental beings he had come across, and as far as Subaru could see, he did not seem to be a fighter.

Subaru: [Umm, this person is…]

Arakiya: [I hate him.]

Subaru: [I don’t want to know who you like or dislike, I want to know what his position is.]

Suspicious Man: [Ah, sorry, sorry. I’m not very attentive at times like these. My naaame~ is Ubilk, and I’m technically a Stargazer at this Crystal Palace. Pleased to make your acquaintance, Stargazer-san of the Kingdom.]

Subaru: [Stargazer… of the Kingdom?]

Subaru tilted his head at that unexpected sound when he was called such by that effeminate man―― the man who named himself as Ubilk, with a frivolous smile still on his face.

However, before Subaru could find out what that meant,

Vincent: [Natsuki Subaru is a Stargazer? Are you certain?]

Ubilk: [If you’re asking me if I’m certain or not, I have no way of confirming it since the Kingdom is outside my jurisdiction, but… I’d wager Your Excellency has come up with a similar theory regarding it.]

Vincent: [A puppet of the stars such as yourself would pose a conjecture as to my speculations?]

Ubilk: [Of course nooot~, I don’t have such a high view of myself as to believe myself capable of guessing the thoughts of Your Excellency, Emperor Vincent Vollachia… I’m just giving a recommendation.]

Vincent: [――. You may speak.]

Ubilk: [I have recited the stars. ――He will beee~ of great use to you, Your Excellency.]

Jerking his chin, Ubilk made that evaluation of Subaru in a light-hearted tone. In response, Subaru pointed at himself and instinctively said, “Me?” out loud.

Truthfully, combining this treatment as a Stargazer, the details of which was still unclear to him, with the discussion about Subaru, made him feel like this exchange being had was going over his head.

Ubilk: [Considering our relationship with the Kingdom, the intention to sever that anxiety of what may come could well give birth to a pretext that will not vanish. If that‘s the case, I believe it would be wise to add him to your hand instead. You have some perfectly convenient hostages, don’t youuu~? It’s a quick way for you both to reach an agreement, no?]

Subaru: [Convenient hostages… Wait, you’re not talking about Rem are you? No way!]

Ubilk: [Ha haah~ ha, you really are an honest person. If you had insisted that this young lady who accompanied you here wasn’t valuable as a hostage, things would have changed a bit.]

Subaru: [Guh, nnn…]

Ubilk: [Ooor~, would you like me to rephrase that just now? The young lady who accompanied him is worthless to Natsuki Subaru…]

Subaru: [Ha? Rem is so precious to me that I would sacrifice my life for her without regret.]

After he replied exactly like that, he witnessed Ubilk’s smile deepen, and Subaru brought his hand to his forehead as he completely fell for the trap.

That said, he could not lie here and say that Rem was worthless to him. 

Subaru: [I’m not Otto. I really can’t say something I don’t mean.]

Otto: [I can’t agree with you calling strategy in a time of crisis proof of a bad character, though!]

Subaru sighed, an imaginary Otto shouting in the back of his mind. Dismissing it with a wave of his hand, Subaru looked toward Vincent. 

Vincent placed a finger on the tip of his slender chin, and looked like he was examining Ubilk’s current proposal. Although, from the look on his face, Subaru could guess that he had already arrived at his answer.

And sure enough――,

Vincent: [――Natsuki Subaru, the situation you have been placed in is far from bright. Regardless of the veracity of your prior poor explanation, the fact remains that you have stepped foot into my country. And beyond that, this is while the Empire has entered wartime and is in the middle of an unparalleled national crisis.]

Subaru: [Wartime… There’s a war!? With who… where!?]

Vincent: [Here.]

Without censuring Subaru for panicking and forgetting to use respectful language, Vincent tapped the floor with his shoe. Subaru blinked, as he momentarily did not connect that response to his question.  

But soon the implication reached his mind…

Subaru: [By here… No way, a civil war in the Empire?]

Vincent: [Precisely. The Emperor and the rebels shall fight over the throne of the Empire.]

Subaru: [――――]

At the confirmation of the reality of a war, a civil war at that, Subaru was involuntarily lost for words. Extending his hand toward that speechless Subaru, Vincent thus announced.

Like a bird of prey, with a gaze and expression of absolute power, the Vollachian Emperor thus announced.

Vincent: [No matter your circumstances, should you want to survive, you shall have to join me, Natsuki Subaru. ――In order to leave the Empire as it should be, in the hands of Vincent Vollachia.]

――Seriously, things had taken a troublesome turn.

Subaru: [――――]

Vincent Vollachia’s declaration caused Subaru to explode in rage with all his heart at the greatest absurdity of fate since he was first summoned to this world.

So far he had encountered many unreasonable situations. It could be said that he had been beaten down by countless absurdities, such as the hardship he had suffered at the Pleiades Watchtower.

And yet, there had still been continuity between them. It could also be said that there had been reasonable logic in how those situations had slowly gotten worse and worse, until it had been driven into an absurd situation.

Yet this time, it was not that way at all.

Subaru’s arrival in the Vollachian Empire, without any warning, had been absurd. If it had not been the Imperial Capital of Vollachia, but a more remote region, or perhaps the Kararagi City-States or the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko that he had been sent to, it would not have been so strange, and yet, it was here.

If he could not call this absurd, then just what could he call it――,

Arakiya: [Ah.]

???: [Uuh, nnn…]

Suddenly, Arakiya noticed something, and let out a sound, followed by Rem on the sofa beginning to stir.

Realizing this was a sign of her awakening, Subaru turned to look at Rem with a snap. Then he knelt next to her on the sofa and waited for her eyelids, framed by her lashes, to slowly open. He could vaguely see himself reflected in her pale blue eyes, and…

Subaru: [Rem! Thank goodness, are you okay? Do you hurt anywhere? Are you injured, or feeling sick? If anything is unusual anywhere, let’s immediately…]

Rem: [――Hk, why are you here!?]

Subaru: [Ghwow!]

After that brief period of him worrying about her condition, the awake Rem immediately shoved Subaru away. Subaru was blown away by the unrestrained power of that strike, and Ubilk lay in his trajectory.

With a “Huuuh~?”, a wide-eyed Ubilk was caught up by the flying Subaru, and the two of them tumbled to the edge of the room, entangled. 

Ignoring Subaru and Ubilk, Rem sat up on the sofa and scanned her surroundings.

Rem: [W-where is that child… and you! From before!]

It was a look that many would undoubtedly mistake the true meaning of. The Emperor, who was too wise, and thus often omitted words that should not be omitted, was laconic even with that expression.

He suspected that he was probably the only one who could correctly interpret the meaning of that expression, given his many years alongside the Emperor.

Chisha: [Ahh, and yet――]

By some chance, maybe, perhaps, he had held some expectation.

That maybe there was someone who could look head-on at this Vincent Vollachia, a magnificently wise Emperor, and an all too foolish and self-deprecating man.

He could not help but think so.

Chisha: [――――]

When light broke through the castle wall, missed the form of Vincent as he was pushed away, and pierced Chisha’s chest as he wore the “mask” of the Emperor, he saw it outside the window.

――An accomplice who should have been far away, was riding a flying dragon and flew toward this place.

None may live, having had their hearts pierced.

Consequently, that was an event inevitable, the terminus of fate as was bound to arrive.

Chisha: [――――]

The man had died.

He was Chesha Trim, became Chisha Gold, and finally as Vincent Vollachia, the man had died.

Before the lord he had devoted his loyalty to, and the accomplice who had assisted him in deceiving that lord, he had died.

――And that was the entirety of what had transpired, in that moment.

△▼△▼△▼△

――And so, the story has converged to the form it should have originally taken, and the time of the Great Disaster has come. 

The hordes of the resurrected dead, commanded by the Witch desiring the destruction of the Empire, shall set the world ablaze.

Despite the gathered Nine Divine Generals joining different camps than they should have, or even having the conclusion of their whole lives changed, to exhibit their greatest valor, they shall set their lives ablaze.

The girls crossing into a neighboring country to search for the cherished boy they were separated from shall witness a heroic turning point that will arrive in the Empire, and without losing hope in the midst of it all, shall set their bonds ablaze.

And the woman like the sun, possessing one half of the two Yang Swords which should have never existed, in order to respond to the horde of the dead whose existence has been twisted and the Witch baring her rage toward her, she shall shine with her unchanging arrogant beauty and set her soul ablaze.

At the core of this story painted with flames and flames and flames, those who witnessed the death of the man who deceived all until the end, with their voices hoarse, tears of blood shed, and souls cracked, they shall set fate ablaze.

???: [――Stand! Don’t give up! Giving up is the one thing I will never allow! You should have known a long time ago why that guy lied to you!!]

???: [Silence, foolish commoner. What in the world can you say about me? I am――]

???: [You are!!]

Both: [The 77th Emperor of the Sacred Vollachian Empire, Vincent Vollachia.]

With trembling knees about to buckle, the man rose.

Desperately keeping his sobbing heart in check, the boy clenched his fists. 

A young girl, blaming herself for her lack of power, told herself there is still more she can do and raised her head, while a child grabbing onto her pointed toward the Great Disaster shaking the Empire and howled.

There was a large hole in the castle walls, and looking down from there, two men lined up.

Side by side, their gazes met, Natsuki Subaru and Vincent Vollachia, two people who joined together with the karma that they should have met far sooner, two people entrusted with this by the man who deceived fate until the end, they shall destroy the advancing Great Disaster, and to seize the future that man desired, they shall face forward.

Vincent: [I am your Emperor, Vincent Vollachia. ――One of the Sword Wolves of the Empire.]

Subaru: [My name is Natsuki Subaru, just a passerby shaking the realm like roaring thunder, but I am the accomplice of the great liar, Chisha Gold!]

The two of them declared their positions, the air of the Imperial Capital resounded with loud and strong voices.

Natsuki Subaru grimaced as he relayed how they had assembled the game board so that the greatest amount of military power would be concentrated in the Imperial Capital when the coming Great Disaster and terrifying hordes of enemies descended upon them.

And then――,

Subaru: [I took the baton you passed me against my will. ――Bring it on, O inevitable fate!!]

△▼△▼△▼△

――It was probably an instance where a single misstep sent the entire journey astray.

With but a single misalignment of gears, the tale twisted askew, and the rails of fate changed course with ease.

When the expected flow of events shifted, the torrent of destiny tossed people around like leaves from a tree.

And yet.

And yet, what if they still finally found their way unto that changeless shore on the other side, unyielding?

Surely, it was only when a strong, unwavering desire utterly deceived that Commandment.

It was precisely within that once-in-a-lifetime lie that the meaning of that man’s life dwelled――,

Chisha: [――If this is my one and only chance for a starring performance, then I shall close the curtains like so.] 

Fin.

With that, that was our annual April Fool’s Day project!

He was a man who had little time on stage in the main story, and only revealed his true intentions at the very end.

He was a character who had nothing revealed except the important parts since he had almost no contact with Subaru. However, if they were to encounter each other in an alternate timeline ――This became the seventh chapter of IF.

In this timeline, the characters involved here and there are different, the development of events Subaru follows changes, and there are individuals he can be deeply involved with and those he can’t, overall it is quite interesting. And yet, in either route, Subaru cross-dresses. It is his fate.

Anyways, thank you for joining me again this year!

I’m glad, since I only wanted to do this on April Fool’s Day, after the Empire arc was done.

How much do the positions of the characters or who survives change between the main story and Azamuku? I think I will bring up these matters again at another time, perhaps in an activity report!

Well, thanks! Have good dreams!
